decision_basis: The exact pinned runtime supports PP and the 23/24-layer split is analytically plausible, but no current orderable same-node rate plus conservative throughput lower bound jointly clears $0.514/M after lifecycle costs.

scope.quality_limit: Inherited current-AWQ absolute-quality failure; this is placement/economics evidence only.

exact_runtime.compressed_tensors_config: pack-quantized int4, group size 32, quant_method compressed-tensors
exact_runtime.placement: vLLM source creates embed_tokens only on first PP rank, lm_head only on last PP rank, and uses make_layers over num_hidden_layers; no new model implementation is indicated.

memory_bound.gpu: RTX 4090 24 GiB, 450 W, SM89, 128 SM, 1008 GB/s, PCIe Gen4 x16, no NVLink, no ECC
memory_bound.kv_basis: 7.436 GiB total c16 BF16 MLA KV band from retained current-AWQ control, divided by serving-layer count; MTP weights excluded because speculative/MTP was not enabled in the control.
memory_bound.admission: Both splits leave about 9.2-12.6 GiB below a 22.118 GiB 90%-utilization budget before framework buffers. This is plausible, not a credible measured admission: the single-card control's non-weight/non-KV peak was about 17.3 GiB and PP duplicates runtime state. A later run must record per-rank peak VRAM and load success before throughput is interpretable.

communication_bound.interpretation: Decode transfer is negligible; long-prefill transfer is not free and can consume roughly 21.5-43 ms per microbatch before software overhead. With only two stages, pipeline bubble and boundary scheduling—not tensor size alone—remain an unmeasured throughput risk.

economics.lifecycle_assumption: 20% allowance for interruption, reload, orchestration, cooling/power, and non-ECC consumer reliability; required rates above are the resulting raw-rate hurdle divided by 0.8.
economics.interpretation: The current 2x market references are not a written matching quote or 12-24 month committed rate, and the 20%-lifecycle raw hurdle is 1000 tok/s at $1.48/hour. No measured or transferable exact-model PP result establishes that floor.

uncertainty: Per-stage vLLM allocator overhead, CUDA graph footprint, and exact PP microbatch schedule were not measured.
RTX 4090 frequency/power/cooling behavior and P2P/host-staging path are venue-specific.
The market page is a current reference, not a topology-matched written quote or sustainable committed rate.
